climate: Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A wine area in Valle de Uco, in Mendoza, the province that makes nearly two-thirds of Argentina's wine, with Los Chacayes, San Pablo and Vista Flores inside. Malbec dominates plantings at 55%, followed by Cabernet Sauvignon (12%) and Chardonnay (5%).
